name: svnbox
description: 仓盒 · 面向 macOS 的多工作副本 SVN 客户端
author: svnbox

scripts.dev: npm run svn:build && npm run themes:build && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run themes:build && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json README.md README.zh-CN.md docs .github && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: node scripts/check-encoding.mjs && prettier --check src tests scripts vite.config.mts vitest.config.mts package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/*.json README.md README.zh-CN.md docs .github && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.release:mac: npm run svn:build && npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && node scripts/release-macos.mjs
scripts.release:mac:preview: npm run svn:build && npm run icons:build && npm run licenses:check && node scripts/release-macos.mjs --unsigned
